note: A version with only two components (spec 2.1). An earlier draft of this format spelled the version MAJOR.MINOR; it is now MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and the old spelling is REFUSED, not read as patch 0. Coercing it would be a guess about which patch the file was written against, and the guess is unnecessary: no VNX file exists outside the Viatrail repository and its author's own test exports, so anyone holding one re-exports. Because the refusal is the only thing that tells the holder what to produce instead, it must name the SHAPE it expected, which is what this file's expected message checks.
